blocked_on: G6/G8 prospective blind evaluation PASS on target-domain labeled data
blocked_reason: No target-domain labeled dataset has been supplied. The prospective blind runner fail-closes (exit 2) on the unfilled template placeholder and prints the minimum unblocking action: supply a target-domain labeled dataset matching the schema in docs/PROSPECTIVE_BLIND_WORKFLOW.md section 2, then fill test_data.path and test_data.sha256 in artifacts/release/prospective_blind_config.json (copied from prospective_blind_config.template.json).

prerequisites.name: Freeze record integrity for the prospective blind run
prerequisites.description: The run config freeze record (veya-freeze-record-v1) validated against the pinned re-minted manifest: checkpoint, shortlist, selective policy, temperature artifact, and git commit pins all agree, and the manifest automation status stayed DISABLED during the run (research/veyabench/run_prospective_blind.py _verify_manifest_links).

prerequisites.name: Blind prospective verdict (P1-P6 pre-registered gates)
prerequisites.description: The one-run prospective blind verdict over the supplied target-domain labeled dataset: exit 0 from research.veyabench.run_prospective_blind, output written once with exclusive creation.
Contamination screens flag <= contamination_tolerance (default 0) blind texts vs the controlled training side; split provenance and contamination run before any statistic.
Clean-slice accepted-risk UCB95 <= frozen epsilon (G1 clean safety).
Clean-slice coverage >= frozen c_min (0.80 in the freeze record).
G2 (per-shift-slice risk UCB95 <= epsilon) AND G3 (shift coverage >= 0.95 x clean coverage) AND G4 (no slice below the collapse floor: coverage 0.05, accuracy 0.30).
Freeze record pins the frozen temperature artifact (models/production/calibration_shortlist_k8.json, temperature 1.971127355603397); the temperature is applied, never refit on evaluation data.
Caller-supplied operational measurements with no failures; a null operational block can only FAIL P6.

activation_steps.acceptance: exit 0 - verdict == PASS and all P1-P6 true. The printed epsilon is the preregistered epsilon the approved policy must select in step 2 (the frozen run config template pins "0.10").

activation_steps.details: Set operating_epsilon to the exact preregistered epsilon that passed. Do not change threshold value. Bind checkpoint_hash, shortlist_sha256, scorer_id.
activation_steps.procedure: Edit artifacts/release/selective_policy.json changing ONLY operating_epsilon: from "disabled" to the preregistered epsilon that passed the prospective blind run ("0.10" pinned by the frozen run config template; threshold 0.896261827143334). Every other field stays byte-identical: thresholds ("0.02": 0.9796500892257723, "0.05": 0.9541679372957224, "0.10": 0.896261827143334, "disabled": null), route "shortlist_k8_packed_rerank", scorer_id "base_decision_head", score "max_probability", checkpoint_hash, shortlist_sha256, chosen_on "validation" with validation_hash, and the validation/test splits and hashes. veya.selective.load_policy fails closed on artifact mixing (different route/checkpoint/shortlist/scorer, chosen_on != "validation", missing validation_hash, or operating_epsilon not present in thresholds).

activation_steps.acceptance: exit 0 - the minted policy selects a preregistered non-null threshold and keeps every binding; the printed selective_policy_hash feeds step 3.

activation_steps.details: Update selective_policy_hash pin only; preserve all other frozen config.
procedure: Edit artifacts/release/manifest.json: (a) set selective_policy_hash to the new policy SHA-256 printed by step 2, and (b) update the automation record to the enabled state citing artifacts/release/prospective_blind_result.json as evidence. Preserve every other pin byte-identically: base_checkpoint_hash, model_config_hash, tokenizer_files, runtime_files, choice.shortlist_hash, routing.choice_router_hash, calibration.packed_choice_hash, calibration.hierarchical_choice_hash, calibration.hierarchical_temperature, data_lineage and blind_evaluation pins, git_commit. There is no dedicated v2 manifest builder (veya/manifest.py build_manifest builds a different per-checkpoint record) - surgically edit only the affected fields.

Re-run the runtime audit so artifacts/release/runtime_audit.json records the new manifest_sha256 (tests/test_artifact_integrity.py::test_runtime_audit_matches_manifest asserts it): .venv/bin/python -m research.veyabench.run_runtime_audit - loads the model, ~34-90 s CPU, ~2 GB RSS.

Regenerate artifacts/release/release_metadata.json AFTER the runtime audit (order matters: the metadata hashes runtime_audit.json and manifest.json, and tests/test_release_metadata.py::test_metadata_mirrors_manifest_and_policy asserts the match): .venv/bin/python -m research.veyabench.release_metadata.
activation_steps.acceptance: manifest selective_policy_hash matches the minted policy file; runtime_audit.json manifest_sha256 matches the re-minted manifest; release_metadata.json manifest_hash matches the re-minted manifest; every other pin is unchanged.

All tests pass and the bundle loads through the production startup path (load_release_manifest -> veya.selective.load_policy), which refuses a missing or mismatched policy artifact before serving; every re-minted pin (selective_policy_hash, runtime_audit manifest_sha256) verifies.

activation_steps.trigger: push a v* version tag (the release-candidate-gate job)
activation_steps.acceptance: The release-candidate-gate job is green: full test suite (pytest --tb=short -q), artifact integrity validation, license inventory check, freeze record validation, and Docker build validation.
The production-evidence-gate job runs (manual trigger only - it never runs on a tag push because it needs prospective evaluation data) and passes with the prospective blind evidence attached.

rollback.action: Set operating_epsilon back to disabled, re-mint policy+manifest, deploy previous known-good image
rollback.trigger: Observed accepted-risk UCB exceeds approved epsilon or drift alert fires
rollback.trigger_detail: drift_triggers risk_breach (a period's risk_ucb95 exceeds epsilon), coverage_drop, distribution_shift, or config_mismatch from research/veyabench/drift_monitor.py; or a failed G1/G2 gate on labeled data (docs/RUNBOOK.md sections 1-2). Never re-select a threshold on the data that showed the breach.
steps: Set operating_epsilon back to "disabled" in artifacts/release/selective_policy.json; thresholds and all bindings stay untouched.
Re-mint the manifest (selective_policy_hash pin and automation record) and regenerate the second-order pins exactly as in activation step 3 (run_runtime_audit, then release_metadata).
Deploy the previous known-good image: git checkout <known-good-release-tag> && docker compose down && docker compose up -d (or kubectl rollout undo deployment/veya).
Confirm /readyz returns 200 and the X-Veya-Policy-Hash header matches the disabled policy hash.

notes: This file documents the conditional procedure only; it does not enable anything. Selective automation stays disabled until every prerequisite passes.
current_state is pinned by tests/test_activation_procedure.py against the actual artifacts; refresh it in the same change as any re-mint (the test fails on drift).
The prospective blind run itself requires the manifest automation status to remain DISABLED (research/veyabench/run_prospective_blind.py refuses otherwise) - the run always precedes activation.
The frozen selective policy thresholds may never be changed; only operating_epsilon may switch, and only to a preregistered threshold key (docs/PROSPECTIVE_BLIND_WORKFLOW.md section 3).

The frozen temperature artifact is models/production/calibration_shortlist_k8.json (sha256 b022512e10ef2141c76cdf380eafe8099f171cbbc2c536f7789a25a29b0a6f50, temperature 1.971127355603397): applied, never refit (P5).
